initial exploration of the networks extracted April 16

```{r}
# NULL networks?

# individual network files
files <- list.files("tijuanabox/int_data/raw_extracted_networks", full.names = T)
extracts <- lapply(files, readRDS)
names <- str_extract(basename(files), pattern = "(?<=extract_).+?(?=\\.RDS)")
for (i in 1:length(extracts)) {
  names(extracts)[i] <- names[i]
}
extracts[1]
```

```{r}
ggraph(networks[[1]], layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(alpha = weight),
                end_cap = circle(1, "mm"),
                color = "#000000",
                width = 0.3,
                arrow = arrow(angle = 15, length = unit(0.07, "inches"), ends = "last", type = "closed"))+
  geom_node_point(aes(color = entity_type, size = num_appearances),  alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Example Network Plot") + theme_void()

```

first looking at top nodes...
```{r}
library(dplyr)
networks <- networks[lengths(networks) > 0]
top_nodes_all_networks <- list()
for (i in seq_along(networks)) {
  g <- networks[[i]] 
  network_name <- names(networks)[[i]]
  deg <- degree(networks[[i]], mode = "all")
  # btw <- betweenness(g, directed = is.directed(g))
  # eig <- eigen_centrality(g)$vector
node_names <- V(g)$name

# store as df per network
nodes <- data.frame(
  network = network_name,
  node    = node_names,
  degree  = deg,
  row.names = NULL) 

# get top 30 
top_nodes <- nodes %>%
  arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

top_nodes_all_networks[[i]] <- top_nodes
}

top_nodes_df <- bind_rows(top_nodes_all_networks)

```
seems mostly sensible, will be able to interpret more once acronyms are resolved

basic stats for each network
```{r}
# get graph-level descriptives for each network
library(tidyverse)
network_info <- lapply(seq_along(networks), function(i) {
  g <- networks[[i]]
  list(c(plan = names(networks[i]),
         n_nodes = vcount(g),
         n_edges = ecount(g),
         density = edge_density(g)
  )
  )
})
network_info_df <- bind_rows(network_info)

stats_overall <- network_descriptives %>%
  summarise(
      median_nodes = median(n_nodes),
      IQR_nodes = paste0(quantile(n_nodes, .25),"-",quantile(n_nodes, .75)),
      avg_nodes = mean(n_nodes),
      sd_nodes = sd(n_nodes),
      median_edges = median(n_edges),
      IQR_edges = paste0(quantile(n_edges, .25),"-",quantile(n_edges, .75)),
      avg_edges = mean(n_edges),
      sd_edges = sd(n_edges)) %>%
  mutate(project_type = "All", network_type = "Full")
```
